The indication that claims 7 and 13-16 would be allowable if rewritten to overcome the rejection(s) under 35 U.S.C. 112 and to include all of the limitations of the base claim and any intervening claims is appreciated.

By this amendment, the subject matter of allowable claim 7 and intervening claims 3 and 6 has been incorporated into claim 1. Claim 1 has further been amended to address the rejection under 35 U.S.C. § 112 thereof. Claim 1 is thus in condition for allowance.

The subject matter of allowable claim 13 has been incorporated into claim 12. Claim 12 has further been amended to address the rejection under 35 U.S.C. § 112 thereof. Claim 12 is thus in condition for allowance.
Claim 20 has been amended to address the rejection under 35 U.S.C. 112 thereof. Claim 12 is now believed to be in condition for allowance.
In view of the above, reconsideration and allowance are now believed to be in order.
